scope: Coverage of the complete stored action table; not restricted to events touched by the current strategy.
limitations: Known payment dates can predate this source review; counts do not certify every source.
Cash availability is the next observed opening after declared payment; a missing later calendar session is not a fabricated date.
Completing the registered 33-event queue does not certify the remaining stored action history or account-level fractional allocation.
Historical industry membership and opening trading-status coverage remain incomplete.
